digest.component_or_area: LLM runner execution pipeline (src/rebar/llm/runner.py and structured_run.py)
propositions: Extract build_model_settings(cfg, req, caps, resolved, cache_settings, *, model_override) and build_usage_limits(cfg, req, UsageLimits) as pure functions from runner.py into structured_run.py

build_usage_limits must return tuple[UsageLimits, req_limit, eff_max_iter] because both req_limit and eff_max_iter are read independently in FailureContext and telemetry logging and eff_max_iter cannot be recovered from the returned UsageLimits object

build_model_settings must remain pure with no side effects; the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation stays inline in run() to maintain the leaf-invariant test that forbids runtime imports of runner into structured_run

Monkeypatch targets that move must be repointed in the same commit; cache_settings parameter is required input not derived inside the function to preserve the model_override guard and avoid silent cache re-enablement on offline TestModel
Extraction must fit within structured_run.py's 100-500 LOC bounds and reduce runner.py to under 700 LOC with measurements recorded in commit message
Seam guard test must be updated with build_model_settings and build_usage_limits added to both hardcoded symbol lists to assert coverage of moved functions
